# Jantar

> Jantar shows every Claude Code session running in Terminal.app on your Mac on one board, on the Mac and on your phone, and lets you answer the ones waiting on you (permission prompts, plans and questions) from the phone. It runs on your Mac as a small daemon on 127.0.0.1; your phone reaches it through your own Tailscale or Cloudflare tunnel. Free, source-available (FSL-1.1-MIT), v{{version}}. Not affiliated with Anthropic.

- Needs: macOS with Terminal.app, Node.js 22.13 or newer, pnpm 10, Claude Code signed in (one account is enough).
- Optional: cswap for several Claude accounts; Chrome 120 or newer for Meetings.
- Optional, off by default: servers (Fleet, v0.6, `jantar fleet on` at the Mac). Linux servers and WSL2 with Claude Code in tmux, and other Macs, join the Mac's board; the Mac is always the hub. Native Windows is a preview. Parts are not yet checked on real servers.
- Not yet: iTerm2, Ghostty; moving a session between accounts.
- No Jantar server, no account with the project, no telemetry.
- Install in one line on a Mac: `{{one-line}}` (read the script first at {{install-url}}).
